notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
description:
Declare Hellkite Charger and Firebending Student as attackers, triggering each of their abilities.
Resolve the Firebending Student trigger, adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.name: Firebending Student
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 7 or greater
